title: After the Shuka Sho: Witch's Dignity

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho claims a spectacular victory at the Shuka Sho. I feel that her performance has even changed the way the spectators see her now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To complete her racing magic, Sweep Tosho needs two more things—a special rival, and to actually be special herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being the Triple Tiara tour representative alone isn't enough. She needs to become even more special.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides that her next race will be the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, where she can run against senior-year Umamusume on the Triple Tiara tour.
